CustomObject.description: Tracks each chemical application event for a Work Order, including EPA registration data, target pest, dose, applicator license, photo evidence, and dual sign-off (applicator + verifier) per Restricted-Use Pesticide (RUP) attestation policy. Drives the Chemical Application Log step of the masseyFlow orchestrator. (API name LOTO_Record__c is preserved from the inherited domain-neutral architecture per SOLUTION_DESIGN Path A; user-facing label is "Chemical Application Log".)
CustomObject.label: Chemical Application Log
